<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 20"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Avatar's Protection](/Feats.aspx?ID=4705) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 121

**Trigger**
You are critically hit by an enemy

**Requirements**
You have an avatar spell prepared

</column>

---

In moments of danger, you can call upon your god’s form in an instant. You cast avatar from your spell slots. The triggering critical hit is reduced to a normal hit, and its damage is applied after gaining the avatar spell’s temporary Hit Points.
name: Avatar's Protection
requirement: You have an avatar spell prepared
